title: SAML 2.0 onboarding wizard: metadata exchange, validation, and diagnostics
creator: Ana Rodriguez
description:
Problem: Admins struggle to onboard SAML 2.0 identity providers to Redwood Private/VPC with confidence. Current setup is manual, fragile, and produces intermittent failures due to metadata mismatches, certificate fingerprint mismatches, and clock skew. There is limited guidance in the Console and insufficient pre-flight validation, leading to duplicated support tickets and delayed integrations.

Goal: Build a SAML 2.0 setup wizard in Console that guides admins through metadata exchange, performs deterministic validation checks, and surfaces actionable diagnostics. The wizard should support: metadata URL upload, direct metadata XML paste, metadata fetch+cache, IDP/SP entity verification, certificate chain validation, signature verification, and basic SAML flow smoke tests (AuthNRequest -> Response). It must emit structured audit events for each step and expose clear remediation suggestions in UI.

Out of scope for this ticket: deep IdP-specific quirks (e.g., Okta attribute mappings beyond required attributes), full provisioning (SCIM), and advanced federated logout flows. Those will be covered in follow-ups once the basic exchange and validation primitives are live.
acceptance_criteria: Console contains a guided SAML 2.0 onboarding wizard reachable from Admin > Authentication > SSO (new 'Add SAML IdP' flow).
Wizard accepts three metadata inputs: metadata URL, file upload (.xml), and direct paste; each path normalizes and stores canonical metadata in the customer tenant.
Server performs a metadata fetch when given a URL and caches with TTL. Fetch failures surface descriptive errors (TLS errors, 404, redirect loops).

Validation steps include: entityID presence, SSO/ACS URL reachability check, certificate presence and X.509 parsing, certificate validity period check, signature verification for signed metadata when present, and clock skew tolerance validation. Failures include actionable remediation text.

Wizard runs a lightweight SAML roundtrip smoke test (unsigned AuthNRequest -> IdP Response) against a test relay endpoint and records result; test optional and behind a feature flag for private deployments.

All user actions in the wizard generate structured audit log events (saml.onboard.start, saml.onboard.metadata.fetch, saml.onboard.validation.error, saml.onboard.complete) with correlation_id and actor.
API endpoints documented for metadata upload and validation (internal docs link included) and covered by 1 integration test and 3 e2e Cypress flows.

Admin UI shows a final summary page with validation status, certificate fingerprint (SHA-256), suggested SLO-friendly configuration (signing required: yes/no), and a prominent 'Enable SSO' toggle guarded by an admin permission.
implementation_notes: Backend: new service saml-orchestrator responsible for fetch, parse, and validation. Expose endpoints: POST /v1/saml/metadata/validate (accepts url|xml), GET /v1/saml/metadata/:id, POST /v1/saml/onboard (commits config).
Metadata normalization: run XML canonicalization (Exclusive C14N) before signature checks; strip comments and whitespace. Store canonical XML in tenant config store and keep raw copy for audit.

Certificate handling: parse all X.509 cert blocks in <KeyDescriptor> and <Signature>. Validate chain up to self-signed root allowed only if admin explicitly permits. Calculate SHA-256 fingerprint and display in UI.

Validation checks: entityID present, at least one AssertionConsumerService (Binding=POST) and SingleSignOnService (Binding=Redirect or POST), valid cert periods, signature algorithm not deprecated (reject SHA-1), metadata signature validation when needed.

Network fetch: implement retry with exponential backoff and follow redirects up to 5 hops. Use tenant-scoped fetcher respecting proxy settings in private deployments. Cache results in redis with configurable TTL.
Diagnostics: collect structured errors and attach remediation hints (e.g., 'Clock skew > 5min: check IdP server time or increase skew tolerance').
Audit logging: append events to tenant audit stream format. Each event includes actor email, ip, correlation_id, metadata_id, and human message. Ensure logs are searchable in Console's Audit view.
Feature flag: gate metadata live fetch and smoke test behind ff:saml-wizard-live-tests to allow safe rollout to hosted first.
Permissions: only users with 'manage:auth' (new RBAC v2 permission) can create/update/delete SAML configurations. Ensure UI respects RBAC v2 role mappings.
test_plan: Unit tests for XML canonicalization and X.509 parsing (covers expired certs, multiple certs, PEM variations).
Integration test that simulates metadata URL fetch with TLS failure, 404, signed metadata, and unsigned metadata.
E2E Cypress scenarios: happy path (metadata URL -> validated -> enable SSO), bad cert path (expired cert shows remediation), and missing ACS path (wizard blocks enable).
CI job that runs the smoke test flow against a maintained test IdP container image (okta-mock) behind a network stub.
rollback_plan: Feature-flag off: immediately disable live metadata fetch and smoke tests. Existing configurations remain functional.
If metadata parsing issues spike, temporarily disable automatic canonicalization step and accept raw metadata while an emergency patch is rolled.
Database migration reversible: keep pre-migration snapshot of tenant saml_config table and provide script to restore.
risks: Fetching arbitrary metadata URLs could be abused to SSRF in hosted; mitigated by tenant-scoped fetcher, allow-listing in private deployments, and internal egress controls.
Incorrect signature validation could lock customers out; ensure human-confirmed bypass only for emergency with audit.
Certificate chain parsing edge cases across vendors; plan for post-launch hotfix window.
